name: message-scroller
description: Chat ScrollView: newest-turn open, follows streamed replies, holds scrolled-up reader, requests history at top.
accessibility: Native ScrollView; VoiceOver, three-finger scroll work; hides nothing.
Pinned within 8 points of bottom; else holds on new turns.
40 points from top: onReachTop fires once per height; prepend re-arms.
Row order = caller order. Give rows .id for scrollPosition.
